tasks.title: Name badge
tasks.starter:
name = input()
form = input()
print("Hello, my name is " + name + " from " + form)

tests.output: Hello, my name is Sam from 7G
Hello, my name is Ava from 7B

hints.spaces: With + Python adds no spaces. Put them inside the speech marks: "is " and " from ".

hints.error: + can only join text to text. Wrap the number in str(), like str(score).
hints.spaces: There is already a space at the end of "Your score is ". Don't add another.

tasks.title: Favourite things
tasks.starter:
food = input()
print("You like", food)
animal = input()

tests.output:
You like pizza
Your favourite animal is cats

You like chips
Your favourite animal is dogs

hints.lines: You need a second print() line for the animal: Your favourite animal is cats.
hints.spaces: The comma adds the space. Don't put a space at the end of the text in speech marks.
hints.other: Print the variable animal with no speech marks, so Python looks inside the box.
